metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct session_skill addressing 15-bit delta overflow handling during timestamp extension in optimistic concurrency control validation. It differs semantically from existing skills (Spring MVC/WebFlux configuration) which operate in completely different domains (web framework migration vs. database transaction timestamp management). Peer candidates address related but non-overlapping concerns (no-wait locking, parallel logging, read-set validation at micro_skill level). The candidate's specific focus on atomic TS_word extension with delta overflow recovery via dummy write is a novel capability not present in the registry.
